title: Atlas DataFlow Analytical Visual Evidence
description: Versioned analytical visual evidence contract. The legacy v1 predictive-classification artifact remains accepted unchanged; internal_v2 (Project Spec S0216) is the Atlas-native multiclass fixed-configuration training profile; continuous_regression_v3 (Project Spec S0228) is the Atlas-native continuous-regression fixed-configuration training profile; native_univariate_forecasting_v4 (Project Spec S0248) is the Atlas-native univariate-forecasting fixed-configuration training profile carrying bounded aggregate forecasting diagnostics only, preserved unchanged as historical forecasting evidence; native_binary_fixed_v5 (Project Spec S0258) is the Atlas-native binary fixed-configuration hist_gradient_boosting training profile, introduced because legacy_v1's closed feature_importance_method.model_family enum structurally excludes hist_gradient_boosting and carries no truthful permutation-importance method discriminator -- v5 is a strict independent branch that never widens or otherwise changes legacy_v1; native_univariate_forecasting_v6 (Project Spec S0270) is the governed native-univariate-forecasting final-holdout visual-evidence evolution of v4 -- it retains every v4 aggregate forecasting diagnostic and additionally requires exactly one bounded final_holdout_forecast_evaluation block carrying temporal context and the exact aligned sealed-final-holdout points (time_index + actual + forecast only), built from the already-computed one-pass holdout evaluation and never a development/history vector, feature/exogenous rows, or model internals; native_univariate_forecasting_v7 (Project Spec S0274) is the governed multi-metric backtesting and horizon diagnostic evolution of v6 -- it retains every v6 required property and validation rule (including the final_holdout_forecast_evaluation block) and additionally requires a bounded forecasting_metric_diagnostics block carrying exactly one diagnostic entry per configured governed forecasting metric (mae/rmse/seasonal_mase), each with a backtesting_by_origin series copied from the already-computed fold summaries and a by_horizon series aggregated from the same single expanding-window backtest (never a second fit/forecast, never a raw fold actual/prediction vector, never a persisted seasonal scale); governed_v2 governs capability-aware, integrity-bound visual collections without authorizing publication or release activation; external_fitted_model_v1/v2 are the validated-external-fitted-model profiles.

external_model_family_v2.description: Project Spec S0215: the multiclass v2 external visualizations profile pairs with the same bounded S0208 estimator family vocabulary as training-parameter-record.external-fitted-model.v2 -- decision_tree in place of v1's gradient_boosting.

internal_v2.description: Project Spec S0216: Atlas-native fixed-configuration multiclass training visual evidence, emitted alongside training-parameter-record.v2/training-metrics.v2. Preserves the same bounded Target Distribution/Feature Importance chart shape as legacy_v1 and additionally requires a governed normalized confusion matrix sourced from the one final-test prediction pass.

feature_importance_method.description: Project Spec S0216: HGB Feature Importance is deterministic permutation importance computed on the final-fit (train+validation) population, never the final test partition, and never used for model selection or hyperparameter tuning.

continuous_regression_v3.description: Project Spec S0228: Atlas-native fixed-configuration continuous-regression visual evidence, emitted alongside training-parameter-record.v3/training-metrics.v3. Never contains classification_evidence or confusion_matrix. target_distribution/feature_importance remain the same two reusable public summary charts as legacy_v1/internal_v2; actual_vs_predicted and residual_distribution are bounded aggregate evidence sourced from the single already-computed final-test prediction vector.

regression_feature_importance_method_v3.description: Project Spec S0231: closed discriminated union so the v3 continuous-regression feature_importance_method truthfully distinguishes the existing direct estimator.feature_importances_ families (gradient_boosting, random_forest) from the hist_gradient_boosting permutation-importance provenance -- a direct-importance family is never required to pretend it used permutation importance, and vice versa.

regression_permutation_feature_importanc.description: Project Spec S0231: HGB continuous-regression Feature Importance is deterministic permutation importance computed only on the final-fit (train+validation) population, never the final-test partition, and never used for model selection or hyperparameter tuning.

regression_actual_vs_predicted.description: Project Spec S0228: bounded aggregate Actual vs Predicted evidence sourced only from the already-computed final-test prediction vector. Never raw per-row actual/predicted arrays, feature values, or row identifiers.

regression_residual_distribution.description: Project Spec S0228: bounded aggregate Residual Distribution evidence (residual = actual - predicted) sourced only from the already-computed final-test prediction vector. Never a raw residual vector.

native_univariate_forecasting_v4.description: Project Spec S0248: Atlas-native fixed-configuration univariate-forecasting visual evidence, emitted alongside training-parameter-record.v4/training-metrics.v4. Never contains classification_evidence, regression_evidence, confusion_matrix, charts, target_distribution_method, or feature_importance_method -- forecasting Dataset Detail renders no Target Distribution/Feature Importance. Bounded aggregate diagnostics only: a full-development seasonal profile, a per-fold backtesting primary-metric diagnostic, and a per-horizon-step MAE diagnostic, all sourced from the already-computed S0244 backtesting/holdout evidence. Never a raw history vector or raw holdout actual/predicted pair.

forecasting_seasonal_profile.description: Project Spec S0248: deterministic full-development-only seasonal means. Cross-field invariants (positions unique and cover exactly 0..seasonal_period-1, observation_count sums to development_observations) are enforced by the producing/consuming code, not by this structural schema -- mirroring the existing normalized_confusion_matrix row-sum convention in this same file.

forecasting_backtesting_fold_metric.description: Project Spec S0248: the configured primary evaluation metric, one point per already-computed S0244 backtesting fold, ordered by fold_index by producing/consuming code convention.

forecasting_horizon_mae.description: Project Spec S0248: per-horizon-step MAE consumed directly from training-metrics.v4.backtesting_evaluation.horizon_mae -- never recomputed. Steps 1..forecast_horizon with no duplicates/gaps for the current complete-fold backtesting protocol is enforced by producing/consuming code.

native_univariate_forecasting_v6.description: Project Spec S0270: governed native-univariate-forecasting final-holdout visual evidence, emitted alongside training-parameter-record.v4/training-metrics.v4 (both identities unchanged). Retains every native_univariate_forecasting_v4 aggregate diagnostic (created_at, training_run_identity, forecasting_evidence, dataset_statistics, seasonal_profile, backtesting_fold_metric, horizon_mae, evidence_policy) with the identical contracts, and additionally requires exactly one final_holdout_forecast_evaluation block. That block does NOT reuse the continuous-regression actual_vs_predicted definition (which is aggregate/bin-oriented and loses temporal identity): it carries bounded temporal context and the exact aligned points of the single sealed final holdout only -- each point is only a canonical time_index label plus finite actual and forecast values, its count is bounded by the governed forecast_horizon and a hard public-safety-compatible maximum of 64, it is derived from the one existing final evaluation (holdout_forecast_vector, y_true_holdout, authenticated row labels), and it is never a development/history vector, feature/exogenous rows, or model/runtime internals. Never contains classification_evidence, regression_evidence, confusion_matrix, charts, target_distribution_method, or feature_importance_method.

forecasting_final_holdout_forecast_evalu.description: Project Spec S0270: the strict internal bounded final-holdout forecast-evaluation block. Cross-field equality/ordering invariants JSON Schema cannot express (len(points) == final_holdout_boundary.observation_count == dataset_statistics.final_holdout_observations == forecasting_evidence.forecast_horizon; first/last point time_index == final_holdout_boundary.start_index/end_index; time_index labels unique and in authenticated source order; development_boundary counts agree with dataset_statistics.development_observations; boundary labels match the authenticated preparation-recipe values) are enforced by the producing/consuming code (pipeline/training.py, publisher/validate.py, api/public_visualizations_loader.py) and their tests -- mirroring the seasonal_profile/normalized_confusion_matrix row-sum conventions elsewhere in this file. No per-point residual/error field is permitted under S0270.

native_univariate_forecasting_v7.description: Project Spec S0274: governed multi-metric forecasting backtesting and horizon diagnostic evidence, emitted alongside training-parameter-record.v4/training-metrics.v4 (both identities unchanged). Retains every native_univariate_forecasting_v6 required property and validation rule -- the identical forecasting_evidence/dataset_statistics/seasonal_profile/backtesting_fold_metric/horizon_mae/final_holdout_forecast_evaluation/evidence_policy contracts -- and additionally requires exactly one forecasting_metric_diagnostics block. That block carries one and only one diagnostic entry for every metric in the governed configured evaluation policy (evaluation_policy.primary_metric plus evaluation_policy.secondary_metrics after de-duplication), each entry pairing a backtesting_by_origin series copied verbatim from the already-computed training-metrics.v4 fold summaries with a by_horizon series aggregated from the same single S0244 expanding-window backtest. Cross-field invariants JSON Schema cannot express (unique metric_id set equals the configured metric set; backtesting_by_origin.fold_count equals the number of fold summaries and by-origin points equal the corresponding fold-summary values; by_horizon steps are unique, ordered, and cover 1..forecast_horizon without gaps; the primary metric's backtesting_by_origin equals backtesting_fold_metric and, when mae is configured, its by_horizon equals horizon_mae; every value is finite, non-boolean, and non-negative) are enforced by the producing/consuming code (pipeline/training.py, publisher/validate.py, api/public_visualizations_loader.py) and their tests -- mirroring the seasonal_profile/final_holdout_forecast_evaluation conventions in this same file. Never a raw fold actual/prediction vector, a persisted per-fold seasonal-MASE scale, a highlighted-score/performance-focus selection, classification_evidence, regression_evidence, confusion_matrix, charts, target_distribution_method, or feature_importance_method.

forecasting_metric_diagnostics.description: Project Spec S0274: the strict internal bounded multi-metric backtesting/horizon diagnostic block. metric_id uniqueness, the exact configured metric set, fold/step coverage, the legacy backtesting_fold_metric/horizon_mae bridges, and finite non-negative numeric enforcement JSON Schema cannot fully express are enforced by the producing/consuming code and their tests.

native_binary_fixed_v5.description: Project Spec S0258: Atlas-native binary fixed-configuration hist_gradient_boosting visual evidence, emitted alongside training-parameter-record.v5/training-metrics.v5. Corrective supersession of the blocked Project Spec S0257's implementation intent -- introduced because legacy_v1's closed feature_importance_method.model_family enum has no truthful hist_gradient_boosting value and no method discriminator. Preserves the same bounded Target Distribution/Feature Importance chart shape as legacy_v1/internal_v2/continuous_regression_v3, and additionally requires a governed binary classification_evidence claim and a strict, truthful permutation-importance feature_importance_method -- never gradient_boosting, never a fabricated method.

feature_importance_method.description: Project Spec S0258: HGB Feature Importance is deterministic permutation importance computed only on the finalized-fit (train+validation) population, never the final-test partition, and never used for model selection, hyperparameter tuning, or threshold selection. random_seed_source names the governed provenance of the seed (execution_contract.random_seed) rather than re-embedding the numeric seed value, which is already recorded in training-parameter-record.v5.

external_materialization_provenance.description: Binds this artifact to the external model/run without ever retaining the absolute external project root: model_family names the validated external estimator family, and external_evidence_reference/external_evidence_sha256 are the same reference and SHA-256 already verified by the canonical notebook's existing external evidence boundary. Project Spec S0194: visual_evidence_origin optionally, truthfully identifies whether that reference/hash describe the external producer's own directly authored evidence (external_evidence_index) or Atlas's own bounded, hash-bound derivation performed only when that producer role was absent (atlas_reference_derivation); its absence preserves the historical S0193 profile unchanged.

target_distribution_method.description: Target distribution is a dataset/prepared-population statistic, distinct from feature_importance_method below; population_kind is fixed to external_prepared_dataset so this artifact never implies the distribution was recomputed inside Atlas.

external_fitted_model_v2.description: Project Spec S0215: multiclass v2 external visualizations profile. Preserves every S0193/S0194 binary discipline established by v1 (Target Distribution and Feature Importance charts, the same evidence_policy) and additionally requires a governed normalized confusion matrix. This profile never embeds raw predictions, raw probabilities, or model bytes, and the materializer that produces it never recomputes confusion-matrix science or deserializes the model.

normalized_confusion_matrix.description: Project Spec S0215: a governed, row-normalized multiclass confusion matrix -- rows are true classes, columns are predicted classes, in the same governed class order carried by the S0208 external classification evidence family. Every cell is a finite fraction in [0,1]; each true-class row sums to 1 within a strict tolerance enforced by validating code alongside this schema (JSON Schema alone cannot express a cross-cell sum constraint). Never raw prediction counts or row-level data.
